seo_title: Find STEM Scholarships for International Women in USA
seo_description: STEM scholarships for international women in the USA. Compare eligibility, deadlines, and award ranges, then apply on provider application paths.
intro: Trying to find USA scholarships that fit an international woman pursuing STEM usually means sorting through overlapping rules on citizenship, study level, field, and application materials. This filtered view brings those themes together so you can compare a focused set of listings in one place. The programs below span categories such as education, STEM, community, medicine, arts, and miscellaneous, and they can apply to different stages from high school senior through college and graduate study. Award amounts vary widely by listing, and deadlines differ by program, so it is worth checking rows promptly and using provider-path context in ScholarshipTop to review current details. Requirements are mixed here too: some listings may ask for essays or more documentation, while others appear lighter-touch, but each scholarship should be compared individually before you apply.
